title: LookWeather
description: Data file content/look/weather.json: how each weather id looks (B2-5 R23): clouds, fog, rain and snow near the camera, light, snow cover, sway, colours. A weather that is only a condition next to the main weather (drought after the dry days) lays its colours and tint over the look of the main weather. Changes blend over the transition_minutes of the climate data, at least min_transition_real_seconds. Calm world (B2466): no camera shake, no flashing. Presentation only, not part of the hash. Values are placeholders.

min_transition_real_seconds.description: Shortest blend between two weathers in real seconds (fast forward shortens the game-time transition; the look still changes softly).

WeatherClouds.description: The cloud layer of the sky shader: calm, fixed shapes; only the cover changes.

color.description: Palette colour id of the clouds (content/look/palette.json).

scale.description: Size of the cloud pattern (larger = smaller clouds).

softness.description: Softness of the cloud edges (share of the pattern).

WeatherGlow.description: The storm glow: instead of lightning flashes a soft, slow brightening of the clouds (B2466: no flashing, at most three light-dark changes per second; the game caps max_changes_per_second at 3 whatever is written here).

max_changes_per_second.description: Most changes between brighter and darker per real second.

rise_s.description: Real seconds a glow takes to brighten fully.

hold_s.description: Real seconds a glow stays bright.

fall_s.description: Real seconds a glow takes to fade.

ambient_boost.description: Ambient light energy added at full glow.

sky_boost.description: Share by which the clouds brighten at full glow.

WeatherLook.description: How one weather id looks. Every value is blended softly when the weather changes.

overcast.description: Share of the sky covered by clouds (0..1).

cloud_shade.description: Brightness of the clouds (1 = bright, lower = dark rain clouds).

fog_density.description: Density of the fog (0 = none; 0.02 hides most things beyond 100 m).

fog_sky.description: How much the fog hides the sky (0..1).

rain.description: Amount of rain near the camera (0..1 of the rain particles).

snow.description: Amount of falling snow near the camera (0..1 of the snow particles).

light.description: Factor on the energy of the sun or moon light.

ambient.description: Factor on the ambient light and the unlit water (never below the night floor of daylight.json).

tint.description: Tint of the light as lowercase #rrggbb (multiplied; #ffffff = none).

shadow.description: Factor on the opacity of the shadows (0 = none under thick clouds).

snow_cover.description: Least share of the ground covered by snow while this weather holds (0..1); the season may show more.

sway.description: Factor on the sway of the plants in the wind.

glow.description: Amount of the soft storm glow (0..1); no flashes, see glow.

colors.description: Colours laid over the colours of the season (dry grass in heat and drought). Only palette colours that a season changes too can move without a rebuild.

FallParticles.description: Small things falling near the camera (leaves; rain and snow in the weather look): drawn as particles in a box that follows the camera target, never part of the world state.

color.description: Palette colour id (content/look/palette.json); a seasonal colour shows its colour of the season.

box_m.description: Edge of the square around the camera target in which they appear (metres).

height_m.description: Height above the camera target at which they appear (metres).

drift_m_per_s.description: Sideways speed along the wind at full wind (metres per real second).

length_m.description: Length of one particle (metres): equal to size_m for a leaf or flake, longer for a rain streak.

spin_deg_per_s.description: Largest tumbling speed (degrees per real second); 0 keeps them aligned with their fall.
